title: RoutingPolicy
description: One per-task-class routing recommendation with the evidence that justifies it. This is where the two measurement tracks (replay/judged quality vs production signals) meet: the triangulation block can state that they AGREE, DISAGREE, or that there isn't enough data — a recommendation built on disagreeing tracks must say so, and nothing in this schema can represent an average of the two. Every aggregate carries n; every recommendation cites its ADRs.

router_version.description: Version of harness/routing that produced this.

status.description: Lifecycle. superseded records are never deleted; supersedes/superseded_by keep the chain auditable.

taxonomy_version.description: A policy is only valid under the taxonomy it was computed against.

risk_constraint.description: Non-null when the recommendation only holds under a risk condition (e.g. cheap tier only where tests exist).

model_id_example.description: Concrete model the tier mapped to when evidence was gathered; tiers are re-mappable as vendors ship models.

skill_ids.description: Skills whose attachment the evidence shows holds quality at this tier.

escalation_tier.description: Where to route on failure/low-confidence classification.

quality_curve.description: Quality per tier for this class, from eval results. Points, not a fitted judgment — the curve IS the evidence.

eval_run_ids.description: Provenance: which eval_result records back this point.

unclassified_fraction.description: Share of overall traffic that is unclassified — reported next to every mix figure so mix percentages can't quietly pretend to cover all traffic.

verdict.description: Whether replay/judged evidence and production signals point the same way for this class. tracks_disagree is a publishable, first-class verdict — there is deliberately no field in which to average the two tracks into one number.

replay_summary.description: What the replay/judged track shows, with its n.

production_summary.description: What production signals show, with their n.

disagreement_note.description: Required in spirit when verdict=tracks_disagree: the honest statement of the conflict and the current best hypothesis for it.

adr_refs.description: docs/decisions/ entries recording the judgment calls behind this recommendation. Glass box: no ADR, no policy.

rationale.description: Human-readable summary of why this recommendation follows from the evidence.
